historical_delay_seconds.rationale: Measured real coverage 68.0% falls in the >= 50% band.
historical_delay_seconds.missing_value_handling: XGBoost: pass NaN through natively (its split-finding algorithm learns a default direction for missing values, no imputation needed). Random Forest (via the existing sklearn preprocessing pipeline): impute with a TRAIN-fit median/most-frequent value plus an explicit missing-indicator column, per the established synthetic-pipeline discipline (src/preprocessing) -- never impute with a fixed global constant computed across train+val+test.
